title: Commercialization
structural_summary: Uses H1, H2, H3, and H4 headings. Extensive use of bulleted lists to detail models, costs, strategies, and competitive points. Contains explicit decision logs in italics.
dominant_content_types: Strategy/Model Descriptions (Monetization, Market Positioning, Growth, Exit)
Lists of Options/Factors (Revenue Models, Cost Components, Competitive Advantages)
key_structural_patterns_observed: Tiered 'Freemium Model' with clearly defined features per tier.
Explicit decision logging (e.g., 'Decision: Ad-free model is mandatory...').
notes_for_ai_consumption: The 'Freemium Model' section is well-structured for extracting tiered feature sets. Decision logs provide explicit constraints or choices. The phased 'Growth Strategy' can be parsed into sequential steps. Lists of advantages and differentiators are good for keyword extraction.
